name: Sinopia
description: The underdrawing’s red earth, pooled at the foot in four stages.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 50% 100%, #000000ff 0.0% 22.5%, #000000bf 22.5% 45.0%, #00000080 45.0% 67.5%, #00000040 67.5% 90.0%, transparent 90%); mask: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 50% 100%, #000000ff 0.0% 22.5%, #000000bf 22.5% 45.0%, #00000080 45.0% 67.5%, #00000040 67.5% 90.0%, transparent 90%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
